title: Hydro-Jetter Service Van Expansion
description: Purchase and outfitting of a secondary commercial service vehicle to clear local commercial and residential drain blockages, capturing unserviced high-margin demand.
assumptions: A qualified secondary technician can be hired and retained within the standard local wage bracket.
Commercial call volume holds steady at a minimum of 3 additional dispatched runs per week.
Vehicle maintenance costs follow standard commercial fleet mileage depreciation paths.
